fact: The Ghana Card Number at Birth System launched on 14 March 2024 with the Ghana Health Service, Births and Deaths Registry and NIA systems integrated, and registered births in Ablekuma West fell 25% from 2,310 (March-October 2023) to 1,722 (March-October 2024) after integration.
title: The Effect of Digital Systems Integration on Birth Registration Rates (Ablekuma West Municipal Assembly, Ghana)
